name: website-learning-fullstack

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build

//overrides: Security fix for transitive dependencies of Next 16.2.12, which is already the latest
release — there is no newer Next to upgrade to. npm's automatic remedy would downgrade
Next to 9.3.3 (a 2020 release, seven majors back), which introduces far more risk than it
removes, so it is refused deliberately.
postcss <=8.5.17: three CVEs that all require attacker-controlled CSS at build time.
sharp <0.35.0: libvips CVEs that require processing attacker-supplied images.
Neither is reachable here (this app has no user-supplied CSS and never processes images),
but pinning the patched versions costs nothing and removes the finding rather than
explaining it away. Re-check with `npm audit` after any dependency change.
